tools.name: search_hts_codes
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a US HTS code, harmonized tariff code or import duty rate for a product, by product words or by a code prefix. Returns ranked 10-digit codes from the current USITC schedule with the description path, general, special and column 2 rates and units, plus a PDF classificatio

tools.name: estimate_landed_cost
tools.description: Use this when the user has an 8- or 10-digit US HTS code and wants the import duty, merchandise processing fee (MPF), harbor maintenance fee (HMF) and total landed cost for a customs value and quantity. Computes ad valorem, specific and compound rates from the current USITC schedule; other rate text
